brief: Finds where a fragment, a pair of bounds, a repeat, a condition or a regular expression occurs in a text, as positions or sections.
detail: It is the search helper of stzString, which builds one over its own engine handle for its Find methods; build one with StzStringFinderQ (or new stzStringFinder) when you only need to search. It never edits the text. Positions are 1-based and count characters, not bytes, so Hebrew, Arabic and emoji text answers as you read it. Find returns a list of positions and a section is a [start, end] pair. Case counts unless you call the CS form with 0. The rank-0 and absent cases are not uniform today: FindFirst and FindLast answer 0 for an absent fragment, IndexOf answers -1, and FindNth answers -1 for a rank past the last occurrence. FindBetweenAsSection is greedy (first opening bound to last closing bound): use FindBoundedByAsSections for one section per pair. The W searches ignore their case flag.
